interface.longDescription: OMEGA v23 strengthens the cumulative OMEGA/ASGARD system with an internal AI/agent CI assurance plane inspired by modern agent-oriented repositories and GitHub Actions. It keeps external Actions optional and implements the core invariants natively: immutable supply-chain references, least-privilege workflow checks, repo-owned landing policy, bounded agent reliability, AI artifact diff/release gates, MCP behavior grading, governed knowledge, scoped session continuity, canonical agent sync, targeted React Native specialists and deterministic demos-as-code while preserving Reality Filter, Kratos and Thor final gates.
defaultPrompt: Use OMEGA v9 to execute this engineering task end to end with observed evidence and maximum justified autonomy.

Use omega_meta_architect for negotiation/TCO, decision matrices, failure memory, drift, service discovery, DAG execution, latency budgets, confidence gates, shadow comparisons and knowledge graph operations.
Never claim online DPO, federated weight synchronization, hidden chain-of-thought auditing, or research-equivalent training unless a real external trainer or verifier actually performed it.
